  As a global enterprise, we have a long-established understanding of federal, state, and local

  Manufacturing
  [Photo of a technician sanding surface with 3M Xtract sander and personal protective equipment]
  
  ### Making the complex world of manufacturing run smoothly
  
  When it comes to fabricating, assembling or processing anything around the world, 3M knows
  efficiency is key. For you, for your team, and for your bottom line. From ultra-strong abrasives
  that keep processes running seamlessly, to futuristic materials that literally lighten your
  workload, and so much more, innovative 3M solutions help you create what’s next.

  Safety

  ### Advancing safe and sound through science
  
  We create safety solutions that help protect people and control their environments across
  industries. From personal protective equipment to infrastructure improvements, our technologies
  help ensure safety in a changing world and allow you to focus on your work with confidence.
  * [Facility Safety][129]
  * [Road Safety][130]
  * [Worker Health & Safety][131]

  Transportation
  ][132]
  Transportation
  [Photo of a commercial airplane parked on an airport tarmac]
  
  ### Helping the world move safely and efficiently
  
  Our science is propelling the transportation industry forward with safer, faster, and lighter
  technologies across the seas, sky, and land. With solutions that can scale from cargo ships to
  scooters, we can help all manufacturers, transporters, and travelers achieve their goals.
  * [Aerospace][133]

  * [Marine][135]

## Who we are

### Align Technology is a global medical device company that is changing lives through better
### smiles. We reimagine and reinvent the way orthodontic and restorative treatment is presented and
### delivered to millions of people around the world.

The Invisalign® System is the most advanced clear aligner system in the world, trusted by over 22
million people worldwide to improve their smiles.

[Learn more][17]

iTero™ intraoral scanners can propel today's dental practice into the future by enhancing the
patient experience and elevating clinical precision.

[Learn more][18]

### CEO 2026 Letter to Shareholders

As I reflect on fiscal 2025, I am proud of how Align navigated a year that demanded focus,
resilience, and disciplined execution. The operating environment remained uneven across regions,
consumer demand was pressured in parts of the world, and we made difficult organizational decisions
to better position the company for the future. Yet through these challenges, our teams stayed
anchored to what matters most—serving doctors and their patients—and delivered a strong finish to
the year.

[Link to CEO letter][19]

infection control, with multiple industry awards that highlight its commitment to excellence and
innovation. With a focus on reliability and performance, we serves dental professionals worldwide
with a comprehensive range of tools and materials that are easy to use and streamline workflows.

# महत्वपूर्ण सूचना

जो कोई भी इससे संबंधित है उसके लिए

यह नोटिस कंपनी एसक्लपियस वेलनेस प्राइवेट लिमिटेड की ओर से प्रकाशित किया गया है, कंपनी इसके द्वारा सभी प्रत्यक्ष
विक्रेताओं, उपभोक्ताओं, कंपनी के प्रॉस्पेक्टस और कंपनी से जुड़े किसी भी व्यक्ति को सलाह देती है।

कि न तो हमारे पास कंपनी के प्रधान कार्यालय के अलावा कोई व्यक्ति भर्ती क्षेत्र है और न ही हम किसी भी भर्ती योजना का
समर्थन / प्रचार करते हैं, आगे हम कंपनी में शामिल होने के लिए कोई शुल्क / शामिल होने का शुल्क नहीं लेते हैं।

यदि कोई आपको कंपनी में नौकरी के संबंध में कोई प्रस्ताव देता है और कोई शुल्क मांगता है तो कृपया तुरंत कंपनी को सूचित करें।
कंपनी ऐसे लेनदेन के लिए कहीं भी उत्तरदायी नहीं है जो किसी के द्वारा शुरू किया गया हो।

तो ऐसे भर्ती के आधार पर धोखाधड़ी वाले लेनदेन से सावधान रहें।

इसके अलावा, कंपनी ऐसे व्यक्ति के खिलाफ अनुशासनात्मक या कानूनी कार्रवाई कर सकती है, जब ऐसा मामला कंपनी के प्रबंधन के
संज्ञान में आता है।

This Too is Healthcare

## See BTG in Action

View the documentary trailer of our 35+ years’ work. Now accepting screening requests.

[Watch documentary trailer][37]

## Support BTG

Join us in shaping the future of healthcare and community health. It takes all of us.

[Learn How to Support][38]

BTG links the provision of health-related service for under-resourced communities with the
interprofessional training of health and social service professionals.

[See our Impact][39]

Since 1990, Bridging the Gaps has connected health and social service professionals-in-training to
community partner organizations, **to better understand and advance community health priorities**.

Income Maintenance. Hoa oversees policy and administration for programs that provide […]

October 7, 2025
On October 7, 2025, we marked a milestone: the BTG 35th Anniversary Symposium. Alumni, students,
faculty, and community partners came together to reflect on decades of impact and to envision the
future of health equity. The day was filled with powerful conversations, shared learning, and a
renewed commitment to advocacy and partnership. Thank you to […]

film explores what happens when healthcare professionals step beyond the clinic and into the lived
experiences of the communities they serve. This documentary […]

## "MORE THAN A SUMMER PROGRAM"

> learn how to rethink what healthcare can become when it’s centered around community and
> connection.”

Megan List, Drexel College of Medicine

Slide

## "energizing"

> "[The BTG interns'] involvement continues to energize our work and expand our reach."

Mercy Howard, Beyond Literacy

Slide

## "Two-way learning experience"

> “... a two-way learning experience - I shared knowledge, but I also learned how to better listen
> and respond to community concerns.

Riley Scheier, Penn School of Dental Medicine

Slide

## "Strengthened our ability to advocate"

> "We had the opportunity to host students for seven weeks, and their contributions significantly
> enhanced our programming and outreach. They assisted with a variety of initiatives that align
> closely with our advocacy goals… Their involvement not only supported our ongoing programs but
> also strengthened our ability to advocate for senior health and wellness through education,
> engagement, and community partnership."

Julie Nelson, Philadelphia Senior Center

Slide

## Expands medical education

> “The experience allowed medical students to witness socioeconomic barriers that impact one’s
> ability to care for themselves.”

Yash Valia, Cooper Medical School of Rowan University

[previous arrow]
[next arrow]

## Get Involved

See how you can make a difference…

$

### Students

**[Subscribe to our mailing list][69]** and be the first to know when applications open for the
**Community Health Internship Program (CHIP)**—a hands-on opportunity to learn, serve, and grow.

$

### Alumni

Engage with the **[BTG Alumni Network][70] (BTGAN)** to connect with peers, share expertise, and
access opportunities for speaking engagements, continuing education, and more.

$

### Community Partners

Interested in hosting BTG students? **[Reach out][71]** to explore becoming a **Community Partner
Site** for the 7-week summer Community Health Internship Program (CHIP).

$

### Donors

Help us shape the future of community health. Your gift supports education, advocacy, and
partnerships that bring direct benefit to communities. **[Donate to BTG][72]**.

BTG links the provision of health-related service for under-resourced communities with the
interprofessional training of health and social service professionals.

## support sensitive teeth and enamel health

###### using Hydroxi™ w/ nano hydroxyapatite

[Learn More][88]

originally developed by NASA for astronauts.

Our teeth & bones are largely composed of a natural mineral called hydroxyapatite with our enamel
being made up of about 97% hydroxyapatite.

Nano hydroxyapatite (nHa for short), was originally synthesized by NASA as a way to repair &
regenerate bone & enamel that astronauts were losing while out in space.

are your teeth addicted to drugs?

Most sensitive toothpastes use a nerve numbing agent called potassium nitrate to temporarily numb
the nerves of the teeth, but when the drug wears off, the tooth pain returns.

Get lasting support for sensitive teeth with Davids Hydroxi™ formula featuring nano hydroxyapatite.

elevated oral care

## elevated oral care

Davids high-performance formulas are made using the highest quality naturally sourced and naturally
derived ingredients to safely and effectively neutralize the bad bacteria in your mouth, remove
cavity-causing plaque, naturally whiten and remineralize the enamel on teeth, and freshen your
breath.

Davids is a high-performing, clean ingredient toothpaste that actually works.

[learn more][89]
premium ingredients
[Davids kids and adults toothpaste in red tube placed on fresh watermelon slices]

## premium ingredients

Davids is committed to being good to the environment by formulating oral care products with
ingredients that are naturally sourced and naturally derived. The ingredients in our non-fluoride
toothpaste, mouthwash, oil pulling, and other oral care products are plant- and earth-based and
processed to enhance performance and safety.

[learn more][90]
sustainable packaging
[Davids toothpaste with key roller next to bamboo toothbrush on glass against mint green background]

## sustainable packaging

Each year, about 1.5 billion toothpaste tubes end up in U.S. landfills. We wanted to do better. You
may have thought we selected the metal tube for its modern aesthetic (that was part of it), but the
main reasons why Davids comes in metal tubes are for maintaining maximum freshness and for their
ability to be recycled.

Our aluminum tubes are lined with a food-grade, non-BPA liner so there is no paste-to-metal contact,
preventing any leaching of the tube material into our non-fluoride toothpaste.

## support sensitive teeth and enamel health

###### using Hydroxi™ w/ nano hydroxyapatite

[Learn More][88]

originally developed by NASA for astronauts.

Our teeth & bones are largely composed of a natural mineral called hydroxyapatite with our enamel
being made up of about 97% hydroxyapatite.

Nano hydroxyapatite (nHa for short), was originally synthesized by NASA as a way to repair &
regenerate bone & enamel that astronauts were losing while out in space.

are your teeth addicted to drugs?

Most sensitive toothpastes use a nerve numbing agent called potassium nitrate to temporarily numb
the nerves of the teeth, but when the drug wears off, the tooth pain returns.

Get lasting support for sensitive teeth with Davids Hydroxi™ formula featuring nano hydroxyapatite.

## elevated oral care

Davids high-performance formulas are made using the highest quality naturally sourced and naturally
derived ingredients to safely and effectively neutralize the bad bacteria in your mouth, remove
cavity-causing plaque, naturally whiten and remineralize the enamel on teeth, and freshen your
breath.

Davids is a high-performing, clean ingredient toothpaste that actually works.

[learn more][89]
premium ingredients
[Davids kids and adults toothpaste in red tube placed on fresh watermelon slices]

## premium ingredients

Davids is committed to being good to the environment by formulating oral care products with
ingredients that are naturally sourced and naturally derived. The ingredients in our non-fluoride
toothpaste, mouthwash, oil pulling, and other oral care products are plant- and earth-based and
processed to enhance performance and safety.

[learn more][90]
sustainable packaging
[Davids toothpaste with key roller next to bamboo toothbrush on glass against mint green background]

## sustainable packaging

Each year, about 1.5 billion toothpaste tubes end up in U.S. landfills. We wanted to do better. You
may have thought we selected the metal tube for its modern aesthetic (that was part of it), but the
main reasons why Davids comes in metal tubes are for maintaining maximum freshness and for their
ability to be recycled.

Our aluminum tubes are lined with a food-grade, non-BPA liner so there is no paste-to-metal contact,
preventing any leaching of the tube material into our non-fluoride toothpaste.

We love all things Dental Checkups!

# Category: dental checkups

## Dental Checkups: A Comprehensive Overview

### Introduction

Dental checkups are an essential aspect of oral health care, providing a regular evaluation and
maintenance routine for teeth and gums. These visits involve a thorough examination, cleaning, and
the detection of any potential issues or diseases. The practice plays a pivotal role in promoting
oral hygiene, preventing dental problems, and ensuring long-term oral health. In this article, we
embark on an extensive exploration of dental checkups, delving into their significance, global
impact, technological innovations, regulatory frameworks, and future prospects. By the end, readers
will gain a comprehensive understanding of this vital healthcare service and its role in improving
overall well-being.

### Understanding Dental Checkups: Unlocking Oral Health’s Foundation

#### Definition and Core Components

Dental checkups, or dental examinations, are scheduled visits to a dentist or dental hygienist for a
comprehensive assessment of oral health. These appointments typically include several key
components:
1. **Medical History Review:** The dentist begins by reviewing the patient’s medical history,
   including any existing dental conditions, allergies, and medications that might impact oral
   health.
2. **Oral Examination:** A visual inspection of the teeth, gums, mouth, and surrounding structures
   is conducted to check for signs of tooth decay, gum disease, oral cancer, or other abnormalities.
3. **Professional Cleaning:** Dental hygienists perform a thorough cleaning process, removing plaque
   and tartar buildup, and polishing the teeth.
4. **X-rays:** Radiographic images are taken to detect issues not visible during the clinical
   examination, such as cavities between teeth or bone loss.
5. **Discussions and Education:** Dentists educate patients on oral hygiene practices, diet, and
   lifestyle choices that promote healthy teeth and gums.

#### Historical Perspective

The practice of dental checkups has evolved significantly over centuries. Early civilizations had
basic understanding of oral care, but organized dental checkups as we know them today are a
relatively modern development. The concept gained momentum in the 19th century with the
establishment of dental schools and associations, leading to more structured oral health programs.
In the early 20th century, the focus shifted towards preventing dental diseases rather than merely
treating them. This period saw the introduction of community dental programs and regular
school-based checkups, laying the groundwork for modern dental care systems.

#### Significance and Broader Impact

Dental checkups serve multiple critical functions:
* **Prevention:** Regular checkups prevent dental problems before they become severe, reducing the
  need for extensive and costly treatments.
* **Early Detection:** They enable dentists to identify potential issues early, such as tooth decay
  or gum disease, when they are more treatable.
* **Educational Value:** Patients gain valuable knowledge about oral hygiene, diet, and lifestyle
  choices that promote optimal oral health.
* **Overall Health Connection:** Research has linked oral health to systemic conditions like
  cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, and respiratory issues, underscoring the importance of dental
  checkups for overall well-being.

### Global Impact and Trends: A World of Dental Care Diversity

#### International Reach and Influence

Dental checkups are a global phenomenon, yet their implementation and frequency vary widely across
countries. Developed nations generally have more established dental care systems, with regular
checkup schedules encouraged for all age groups. In contrast, many developing countries struggle
with limited access to dental services, leading to higher prevalence rates of dental diseases. The
World Health Organization (WHO) estimates that over 3.5 billion people worldwide lack adequate
access to oral health care.

#### Regional Trends and Disparities

Region  │Average Dental Checkup Frequency (per year)│Key Challenges                                 
────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────
North   │High, with many countries advocating       │Rising dental costs, limited insurance coverage
America │bi-annual checkups                         │for routine care                               
────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────
Europe  │Regular, with varying schedules across     │Aging population, decreasing number of dentists
        │countries                                  │in rural areas                                 
────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────

## Dental Checkups: A Comprehensive Overview

### Introduction

Dental checkups are an essential aspect of oral health care, providing a regular evaluation and
maintenance routine for teeth and gums. These visits involve a thorough examination, cleaning, and
the detection of any potential issues or diseases. The practice plays a pivotal role in promoting
oral hygiene, preventing dental problems, and ensuring long-term oral health. In this article, we
embark on an extensive exploration of dental checkups, delving into their significance, global
impact, technological innovations, regulatory frameworks, and future prospects. By the end, readers
will gain a comprehensive understanding of this vital healthcare service and its role in improving
overall well-being.

### Understanding Dental Checkups: Unlocking Oral Health’s Foundation

#### Definition and Core Components

Dental checkups, or dental examinations, are scheduled visits to a dentist or dental hygienist for a
comprehensive assessment of oral health. These appointments typically include several key
components:
1. **Medical History Review:** The dentist begins by reviewing the patient’s medical history,
   including any existing dental conditions, allergies, and medications that might impact oral
   health.
2. **Oral Examination:** A visual inspection of the teeth, gums, mouth, and surrounding structures
   is conducted to check for signs of tooth decay, gum disease, oral cancer, or other abnormalities.
3. **Professional Cleaning:** Dental hygienists perform a thorough cleaning process, removing plaque
   and tartar buildup, and polishing the teeth.
4. **X-rays:** Radiographic images are taken to detect issues not visible during the clinical
   examination, such as cavities between teeth or bone loss.
5. **Discussions and Education:** Dentists educate patients on oral hygiene practices, diet, and
   lifestyle choices that promote healthy teeth and gums.

#### Historical Perspective

The practice of dental checkups has evolved significantly over centuries. Early civilizations had
basic understanding of oral care, but organized dental checkups as we know them today are a
relatively modern development. The concept gained momentum in the 19th century with the
establishment of dental schools and associations, leading to more structured oral health programs.
In the early 20th century, the focus shifted towards preventing dental diseases rather than merely
treating them. This period saw the introduction of community dental programs and regular
school-based checkups, laying the groundwork for modern dental care systems.

#### Significance and Broader Impact

Dental checkups serve multiple critical functions:
* **Prevention:** Regular checkups prevent dental problems before they become severe, reducing the
  need for extensive and costly treatments.
* **Early Detection:** They enable dentists to identify potential issues early, such as tooth decay
  or gum disease, when they are more treatable.
* **Educational Value:** Patients gain valuable knowledge about oral hygiene, diet, and lifestyle
  choices that promote optimal oral health.
* **Overall Health Connection:** Research has linked oral health to systemic conditions like
  cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, and respiratory issues, underscoring the importance of dental
  checkups for overall well-being.

### Global Impact and Trends: A World of Dental Care Diversity

countries. Developed nations generally have more established dental care systems, with regular
checkup schedules encouraged for all age groups. In contrast, many developing countries struggle
with limited access to dental services, leading to higher prevalence rates of dental diseases. The
World Health Organization (WHO) estimates that over 3.5 billion people worldwide lack adequate
access to oral health care.

hygiene kits and coordinating units/case, total price, PPU, etc. was complicated. They had me email
my planning sheet and spent time on the phone suggesting substitutions and optimizing our budget.
Ultimately, we are able to provide significantly more aid with the same budget.

### Jullian C.

The middle school supply kit was exactly what I was looking for. All the key pieces were in there
for students to get a start on their school supplies. The students will love the bright and varied
colors in each kit. And the price was right. Overall, it's a great value.

### Jamie R.

It is a pleasure to do business with the company and employees. It is nice to work with a real
person that is enthusiastic about helping and is so responsive. That is why I keep coming back each
year.

### Donald S.

As a premier wholesale supplier, DollarDays is the online destination for nonprofits, businesses and
others to buy items in bulk and get wholesale prices on what they need to accomplish their missions.
We're proud to have served and provided affordable new products for charities, churches, schools and
other organizations looking to make their budgets go further.

don't find the right wholesale items for your organization or event, [contact us][48] and we can
help customize an order specific to your needs.

1 Most people know they should floss

People already know flossing matters. Awareness isn’t the barrier — adherence is. The real issue is
turning flossing into a routine that fits daily life.

2 Traditional floss is easy to skip

Traditional floss can feel inconvenient, awkward, or easy to postpone when you’re busy, outside the
house, or tired.

3 Skipping flossing adds up

When flossing is inconsistent, food debris and plaque can stay between teeth, which may contribute
to bad breath, gum irritation, and long-term oral health problems.

4 Gfloss makes consistency easier

Gfloss helps remove friction from flossing by making it easier, more discreet, and easier to fit
into real life.

Gfloss was created to help close this habit gap — making flossing easier, more discreet, and easier

### **ACCEPTING CANADIAN DENTAL CARE PLAN**

**Affordable, healthy smiles begin at Glen Abbey Smiles Dental Hygiene**

Ontario residents have had the choice of receiving professional dental hygiene treatment by
Registered Dental Hygienists Since September 2007, without having to see the dentist. Dental Hygiene
is a regulated profession governed by the College of Dental Hygienists of Ontario, and for decades
dental hygienists have been the primary providers of preventive oral care.

Glen Abbey Smiles Dental Hygiene (formerly JW Dental Hygiene), located in Oakville, is a independent
dental hygiene clinic offering affordable dental cleaning, periodontal therapy, fluoride treatment,
oral hygiene instructions, teeth whitening, sports guard, oral cancer screening and complete oral
evaluation in a comfortable and inviting atmosphere.  Essential oils are aromatically diffused in
the room to help alleviate any anxiety you may have while visiting a dental hygiene office.  Enjoy a
nice moist scented cloth to freshen up after your treatment.

Our approach to each client is very specific and is based on the unique needs and concerns of the
individual. We provide the highest level of care possible and make it affordable so clients can take
control of their oral health.

[Dental Hygiene]

 

At Glen Abbey Smiles Dental Hygiene you get the same quality of dental hygiene care as you would at
a traditional dental office.  You may continue to see your dentist or we can refer you to one for
your regular dental checkup.

Glen Abbey Smiles Dental Hygiene (formerly JW Dental Hygiene), provides quality and affordable care
that is responsive to the needs of the community of Oakville and surrounding areas. We serve many
people from Oakville, Mississauga, Burlington, Hamilton, Milton and Brampton.  We look forward to
seeing you!

**Your Dental Hygiene Visit will include: **
•Dental Hygiene Examination
•Complete Teeth Scaling, Polish and Fluoride Treatment if necessary
•Oral Hygiene Kit

Friday: 9:00 am to 2:00 pm

### **ACCEPTING CANADIAN DENTAL CARE PLAN**

**Affordable, healthy smiles begin at Glen Abbey Smiles Dental Hygiene**

Ontario residents have had the choice of receiving professional dental hygiene treatment by
Registered Dental Hygienists Since September 2007, without having to see the dentist. Dental Hygiene
is a regulated profession governed by the College of Dental Hygienists of Ontario, and for decades
dental hygienists have been the primary providers of preventive oral care.

Glen Abbey Smiles Dental Hygiene (formerly JW Dental Hygiene), located in Oakville, is a independent
dental hygiene clinic offering affordable dental cleaning, periodontal therapy, fluoride treatment,
oral hygiene instructions, teeth whitening, sports guard, oral cancer screening and complete oral
evaluation in a comfortable and inviting atmosphere.  Essential oils are aromatically diffused in
the room to help alleviate any anxiety you may have while visiting a dental hygiene office.  Enjoy a
nice moist scented cloth to freshen up after your treatment.

Our approach to each client is very specific and is based on the unique needs and concerns of the
individual. We provide the highest level of care possible and make it affordable so clients can take
control of their oral health.

[Dental Hygiene]

 

At Glen Abbey Smiles Dental Hygiene you get the same quality of dental hygiene care as you would at
a traditional dental office.  You may continue to see your dentist or we can refer you to one for
your regular dental checkup.

Glen Abbey Smiles Dental Hygiene (formerly JW Dental Hygiene), provides quality and affordable care
that is responsive to the needs of the community of Oakville and surrounding areas. We serve many
people from Oakville, Mississauga, Burlington, Hamilton, Milton and Brampton.  We look forward to
seeing you!

**Your Dental Hygiene Visit will include: **
•Dental Hygiene Examination
•Complete Teeth Scaling, Polish and Fluoride Treatment if necessary
•Oral Hygiene Kit

## Stories to live by. Lessons to inspire.

### Maria’s story

“If you have a disability, it’s really hard to find your place in this world,” says collegiate para
track and field athlete Maria Velat. After becoming paralyzed in high school, Maria found her way
back to sports, and now competes through the Adaptive Student Athlete Program (ASAP), a national
program co-founded by Guardian and University of Michigan Adaptive Sports and Fitness to expand
access to competitive opportunities for para athletes. Maria’s goal is to work toward a day when
adaptive sports are seen as equal.

Watch the video

### Caiden’s story

At 15, Caiden experienced a life-changing accident that paralyzed him, requiring the use of a
wheelchair. His life changed again when he picked up a tennis racquet. After a rocky start, his
wheelchair tennis team took second place at the national championships, and Caiden's sense of
community and sportsmanship was able to shine through again.

Watch the video

### A lifetime of good oral health

From the time a child’s first tooth comes in, how they learn to take care of their teeth can have a
positive impact on their health and well-being for years to come. Guardian helps our youngest
members establish a lifetime of good oral health and well-being.

Watch the video

### Building financial education with EVERFI

Financial health has an outsized impact on the well-being of the whole you. So, we partnered with
EVERFI to deliver a free digital financial education course that teaches high school students about
different financial stages in life, how money and mental health are intertwined, and how money can
affect interpersonal relationships.

Watch the video

### Greer’s story

Greer’s husband unexpectedly passed away, leaving her with two young children and a brand new home.
Her careful planning with her financial professional allowed her to get back to focusing on what
mattered.

Watch the video

### Ed and Mary Ann’s story

After 57 years of marriage, Ed and Mary Ann were facing their greatest challenge yet — pancreatic
cancer. But careful planning with their financial professional set them up for financial confidence
to enjoy their time together.

Watch the video

## The GuruNanda Method

Seven simple steps — morning and night — that work together for a cleaner, healthier, brighter
mouth. Tap any step to learn more.

1 Oil Pulling 2 Flossing 3 Water Flossing 4 Tongue Scraping 5 Brushing 6 Rinsing 7 Whitening
[[Oil Pulling]][122]
Step 1

### Oil Pulling

2 min

Begin your routine with the ancient Ayurvedic practice trusted for centuries. GuruNanda Pulling Oils
help freshen breath, promote healthy gums, and support a cleaner-feeling mouth before brushing. It's
the first step toward a healthier oral care routine and a more confident smile.

[Shop Oil Pulling][123]
[[Flossing]][124]
Step 2

### Flossing

1 min

A toothbrush only reaches part of your smile. Flossing helps remove food particles and buildup from
between teeth, supporting a cleaner, fresher mouth every day.

[Shop Floss][125]
[[Water Flossing]][126]
Step 3

### Water Flossing

1 min

Take your routine further with the power of water. Water flossing helps rinse hard-to-reach areas
around teeth, along the gumline, and around dental work for a more complete clean.

[Shop Water Flossers][127]
[[Tongue Scraping]][128]
Step 4

### Tongue Scraping

15 sec

This is the most overlooked step in oral care and the one that makes an immediate difference because
most bad breath originates on the tongue—not between the teeth. A quick scrape removes more
odor-causing bacteria than brushing your tongue ever could.

[Shop Tongue Scrapers][129]
[[Brushing]][130]
Step 5

### Brushing

2 min

Pair the ultra-soft comfort of our Butter on Gums® Toothbrush with a toothpaste designed to do more.
Whether you choose our Neem Hydroxyapatite formula or Sensitive Toothpaste, every brush helps
support strong teeth, promote healthy gums, and leave your mouth feeling exceptionally clean and
refreshed.

[Shop Brushing][131]
[[Rinsing]][132]
Step 6

### Rinsing

30 sec

Oral rinses help reach areas of the mouth brushing cannot while leaving your mouth feeling clean and
refreshed. With focused options for gingivitis, cavity protection, oral sores, and dry mouth, our
therapeutic oral rinses are the perfect finishing touch to your daily routine.

[Shop Mouthwash][133]
[[Whitening]][134]
Step 7

### Whitening

As needed

Enhance your smile with whitening solutions designed for everyday confidence. Help lift surface
stains and restore a brighter, more radiant appearance.

[Shop Whitening][135]

## HIGHLIGHTS

**IVISMILE X UNILEVER**

IVISMILE is honored to join “Partner to Win 2025,” Unilever’s prestigious strategic program
dedicated to fostering innovation, collaboration, and long-term success with suppliers. This
opportunity strengthens our commitment to excellence and global partnerships.

[WhatsApp Image 2025-04-02 at 10.52.37 PM]

###### Industry leading solutions

## World Class Facilities

A leading innovator in private label oral care manufacturing and development.

At IVISMILE, we shine the spotlight on your brand – our labels feature your name, not ours. Our aim
is to offer customized labels and products that enhance your customers’ beautiful smiles,
emphasizing collaboration over competition.

#### Innovation

We pride ourselves on innovation and leading technology in oral care manufacturing as the **first
manufacturer** of the **wireless teeth whitening kit** (IVISMILE 4) and the developer of the
**patented LED electric toothbrush** (ETB T2). We also produce Water Flossers, Gels, Mouthpieces,
Strips, and Toothpaste, reflecting our commitment to advanced, high-quality oral care. The team
consists of world class designers, scientists, and engineers that create unparalleled products. We
do extensive research and development on every product we produce.

We have more than 40 worldwide inventions and use our expertise to bring our customers products that
keep them in the forefront of our industry. Our innovations include exclusive formula creation,
design and development, sampling, molding, testing, and best in class production. Partners can
expect a quick turnaround time on exclusive designed products that make their companies unique and
competitive in the industry.

#### Manufacturing

IVISMILE is certified by SGS (headquartered in Switzerland) for ISO22716, ISO9001, GMP, BSCI for
manufacturing systems, as well as certified BPA Free, FCC and CE for our products. Quality
management, quality manufacturing and quality products are the results of our hard-working team. We
consistently produce world class products because each of our team members complete intensive
training pertaining to his/her job to ensure precision on our production lines and to focus on our
customers in every aspect of our business.

The entire production is done in our dust-free workshop with controlled airflow, highly managed
equipment and sanitization. Under GMP, all steps on production lines are supervised and documented
from initial material input to final output, including sampling prior to final delivery. Clarity in
the system is a necessity to ensure peace of mind of our clients.

###### Industry leading solutions

## World Class Facilities

A leading innovator in private label oral care manufacturing and development.

At IVISMILE, we shine the spotlight on your brand – our labels feature your name, not ours. Our aim
is to offer customized labels and products that enhance your customers’ beautiful smiles,
emphasizing collaboration over competition.

#### Innovation

We pride ourselves on innovation and leading technology in oral care manufacturing as the **first
manufacturer** of the **wireless teeth whitening kit** (IVISMILE 4) and the developer of the
**patented LED electric toothbrush** (ETB T2). We also produce Water Flossers, Gels, Mouthpieces,
Strips, and Toothpaste, reflecting our commitment to advanced, high-quality oral care. The team
consists of world class designers, scientists, and engineers that create unparalleled products. We
do extensive research and development on every product we produce.

We have more than 40 worldwide inventions and use our expertise to bring our customers products that
keep them in the forefront of our industry. Our innovations include exclusive formula creation,
design and development, sampling, molding, testing, and best in class production. Partners can
expect a quick turnaround time on exclusive designed products that make their companies unique and
competitive in the industry.

#### Manufacturing

IVISMILE is certified by SGS (headquartered in Switzerland) for ISO22716, ISO9001, GMP, BSCI for
manufacturing systems, as well as certified BPA Free, FCC and CE for our products. Quality
management, quality manufacturing and quality products are the results of our hard-working team. We
consistently produce world class products because each of our team members complete intensive
training pertaining to his/her job to ensure precision on our production lines and to focus on our
customers in every aspect of our business.

The entire production is done in our dust-free workshop with controlled airflow, highly managed
equipment and sanitization. Under GMP, all steps on production lines are supervised and documented
from initial material input to final output, including sampling prior to final delivery. Clarity in
the system is a necessity to ensure peace of mind of our clients.

## How OEM & Ship OEM Works

1

#### Supply Chain Solutions

#### Sample Testing

#### Approval & Mass Production

#### Delivery

#### Quality Assurance

volume and budget. Custom logo, color, bristle type, handle design, and packaging — from blister
cards to retail boxes. Low MOQ from 500 pieces, samples in 7 days.

We are a small, hands-on team based in China. We do not own factories — we own relationships with
10+ vetted manufacturers, the QC process, and the commitment to make your sourcing transparent and
hassle-free. Every order is checked before shipping. If something cannot be done, we tell you
upfront

### OEM / Brand Custom

Your brand, your design, your market. Full customization from packaging to product specs.
* Your private label products
* Custom packaging design
* Customized product specs
* No MOQ required

[Read Customization Details][21]

## How OEM & Ship OEM Works

1

#### Supply Chain Solutions

We connect you with the right factory based on your product requirements and budget.

2

#### Sample Testing

Review samples, test quality, and confirm specifications before mass production.

3

#### Approval & Mass Production

After your approval, production begins with regular quality checks throughout.

4

#### Delivery

We handle logistics and shipping, delivering your products to your doorstep worldwide.

[Learn More about OEM →][22]

## Why Work With LMS Oral

A small, hands-on team. No factory claims — just real relationships and reliable quality control.

🎓

#### Supplier Vetting

Every factory in our network passes a multi-point evaluation: certifications, production audits, and
sample quality checks before we list any product.

💡

#### Documentation Support

FDA, CE, ISO 13485 compliance documents for your target markets — we verify, organize, and share
them so you don’t have to chase suppliers.

🔍

#### Quality Assurance

Pre-shipment inspection on every order. Photos and video reports before dispatch. We stand between
you and the factory, not behind a screen.

[Learn About Our Process →][23]

## Toothbrushes & Dental Floss We Source

We help brands and distributors source quality toothbrushes and dental floss from vetted factories
in China. Every product is checked before shipment — honest quality, no inflated claims.
* **Manual Toothbrushes** — bamboo, charcoal, soft/medium/hard bristle
* **Electric Toothbrushes** — sonic and rotating, adults & kids
* **Dental Floss Picks** — single/dual-line, mint, various counts
* **Biodegradable Dental Floss** — eco-friendly, ECOCERT certified
* **Interdental Brushes** — multiple sizes, rubber-coated wire
* **Orthodontic Floss & Wax** — for braces and orthodontic care

## OEM & Custom Branding

Want your own brand on toothbrushes or dental floss? We coordinate with the right factory for your
volume and budget. Custom logo, color, bristle type, handle design, and packaging — from blister
cards to retail boxes. Low MOQ from 500 pieces, samples in 7 days.

## Why Work With LMS Oral

We are a small, hands-on team based in China. We do not own factories — we own relationships with
10+ vetted manufacturers, the QC process, and the commitment to make your sourcing transparent and
hassle-free. Every order is checked before shipping. If something cannot be done, we tell you
upfront. No hidden costs, just reliable products delivered on time.

## Ready to Start Your Oral Care Brand?

Your partner all the way across from sample to final products.

[Start Now][24]

## Who We Are

## We are all equipped
## to lead

### Our Vision

For communities around the world  to achieve greater levels of education, improved health, and
increased economic security.

### Our Mission

To address communities’ pressing needs by empowering current leaders  and readying leaders of
tomorrow.

[ GET TO KNOW US ][76]

## What We Do

## Our Areas of Work

## Economic Security

Economic stability remains a complex and ever-changing challenge worldwide. From the impact of the
COVID-19 pandemic to technological shifts and climate concerns, communities, especially the more
vulnerable, are navigating new realities.

MCW Global and its Affiliates in Africa, MC-Tanzania, MC-Rwanda, and MC-Zambia work to address these
challenges head-on, supporting local initiatives and leaders that promote sustainable livelihoods,
skill-building, and inclusive economic opportunities for all.

## Education

Education is a powerful driver of community transformation, and at MCW Global, we support access to
quality education and believe equitable education is not only a right but a foundation for long-term
social impact. This commitment is deeply rooted not only in our values but also in our efforts, from
scholarships, conferences, and webinars for young leaders worldwide to grassroots literacy projects
in Zambia and resource development in Rwandan libraries.

## Health

Access to health care remains unequal around the world, particularly for underserved communities.
Through the work of our Affiliates in Tanzania, Rwanda, and Zambia, we promote health awareness and
deliver community-based services. A key example is MC-Tanzania’s Dental Therapist Outreach Training
Program, which brings oral health services to rural regions twice a year in partnership with local
health colleges. Together, we’re working toward healthier futures for all.

## Leadership

## (Cross-cutting)

Strong, compassionate leadership is essential to solving today’s global challenges- from climate
change and inequality to economic security, quality education, and health care for all. At MCW
Global, we are committed to empowering the next generation of leaders through our core programs
while recognizing that leadership is not a position but an action that all can take. Each year, we
support hundreds of young people who are creating positive, lasting change in their communities and
beyond.

## Discover Our Impact: 2024 Annual Report

## The Corner ® Annual Report 2024

 

Explore our latest annual report, a testament to the resilience of individuals worldwide in the face
of unprecedented challenges.

This report highlights our collective efforts and the remarkable progress achieved. From reopening
classrooms to reigniting our passion for community, MCW has been at the forefront.

We proudly share stories of triumph and perseverance, from in-person programs in Africa to joint
conferences and the graduation of our Young Leaders Fellowship Program cohorts.

Join us in celebrating these triumphs in our latest annual report. Thank you for your unwavering
support!

challenges head-on, supporting local initiatives and leaders that promote sustainable livelihoods,
skill-building, and inclusive economic opportunities for all.

## Education

Education is a powerful driver of community transformation, and at MCW Global, we support access to
quality education and believe equitable education is not only a right but a foundation for long-term
social impact. This commitment is deeply rooted not only in our values but also in our efforts, from
scholarships, conferences, and webinars for young leaders worldwide to grassroots literacy projects
in Zambia and resource development in Rwandan libraries.

## Health

Access to health care remains unequal around the world, particularly for underserved communities.
Through the work of our Affiliates in Tanzania, Rwanda, and Zambia, we promote health awareness and
deliver community-based services. A key example is MC-Tanzania’s Dental Therapist Outreach Training
Program, which brings oral health services to rural regions twice a year in partnership with local
health colleges. Together, we’re working toward healthier futures for all.

## Leadership

## (Cross-cutting)

Strong, compassionate leadership is essential to solving today’s global challenges- from climate
change and inequality to economic security, quality education, and health care for all. At MCW
Global, we are committed to empowering the next generation of leaders through our core programs
while recognizing that leadership is not a position but an action that all can take. Each year, we
support hundreds of young people who are creating positive, lasting change in their communities and
beyond. 

[ LEARN MORE ][77]

## Our Global Impact

## We have impacted 86 countries and territories around the world

This includes the home countries of our alumni, the locations of our programs, and the places where
we partnered with independent organizations. Our global reach reflects the diverse and collaborative
nature of our work, driven by a shared commitment to creating positive change.

offer a secure platform to facilitate the supply of quality products across domestic and foreign
countries. As an import & export.  business, we seek to provide real services to exporters and
importers who are committed to the worldwide supply of commodities around the entire world. We deal
reasonably with producers, farmers, wholesalers, importers, and other stakeholders to establish a
strong global presence in international trade right away. Being an import export company,  our final
aspiration is to close the gap in the foreign market between buyers and sellers. In order to offer
the highest quality of merchandise, ensure customer satisfaction and cultivate customer loyalty, we

Establishing a business abroad can be a complex task. We possess the ability to guide its clients

### Our determination as an international trading company

Importers and exporters can quickly be confused in the international business for the first time by

### Mudra Global: A committed FMCG exporter

Fast moving consumer goods, also referred to as packed consumer goods, are the kind of items that
are delivered easily and at a reasonably low prices. There is a wide area for [FMCG exports][44] as
there are many products in a single domain. Such fast-moving consumer products are in hot demand,
making export trade a perfect choice.

Mudra Global, a major player in the export of FMCG products, provides the right forum to connect
foreign trade between buyers and sellers. Mudra Global aims to reduce the gap between consumer
product demands and supplies and provides quality products to various parts of the globe. The goods
come from some of the country’s biggest producers, such as ITC, Nestle Himalaya, Fabre Castle,
Unilever, etc.

# India's B2B Export Marketplace - Source from 51 Categories

Navi Exports connects verified Indian exporters with importers across 20+ countries. Browse 51
product categories - from Agriculture & Spices to Gems & Jewelry, Textiles, and Industrial
Equipment. Register free and start sourcing wholesale from India today.

## Why Source from India? The World's Fastest-Growing Export Hub

India is one of the world's largest and most diverse export economies, producing high-quality goods
across agriculture, textiles, gems, engineering, and more. **Navi Exports** is a B2B export
marketplace that brings verified Indian exporters and global importers together on a single, trusted
platform.

Whether you are an importer looking to buy wholesale from India for the first time, or an
established business expanding your Indian supplier network, our platform makes it simple. Browse
**51 product categories** - from Agriculture & Food, Spices, Gems & Jewelry, and Textiles to
Electronics, Industrial Equipment, and Chemicals. Connect directly with **200+ verified exporters**
based in Rajasthan and across India, serving buyers in **20+ countries** worldwide.

Every exporter on Navi Exports is vetted before listing. Our platform supports secure transactions,
end-to-end trade management, and dedicated support - making international sourcing from India
reliable, transparent, and efficient. [Register free as an importer][275] or [list your products as
an exporter][276] and start trading globally today.

# India's B2B Export Marketplace - Source from 51 Categories

Navi Exports connects verified Indian exporters with importers across 20+ countries. Browse 51
product categories - from Agriculture & Spices to Gems & Jewelry, Textiles, and Industrial
Equipment. Register free and start sourcing wholesale from India today.

## Why Source from India? The World's Fastest-Growing Export Hub

India is one of the world's largest and most diverse export economies, producing high-quality goods
across agriculture, textiles, gems, engineering, and more. **Navi Exports** is a B2B export
marketplace that brings verified Indian exporters and global importers together on a single, trusted
platform.

Whether you are an importer looking to buy wholesale from India for the first time, or an
established business expanding your Indian supplier network, our platform makes it simple. Browse
**51 product categories** - from Agriculture & Food, Spices, Gems & Jewelry, and Textiles to
Electronics, Industrial Equipment, and Chemicals. Connect directly with **200+ verified exporters**
based in Rajasthan and across India, serving buyers in **20+ countries** worldwide.

Every exporter on Navi Exports is vetted before listing. Our platform supports secure transactions,
end-to-end trade management, and dedicated support - making international sourcing from India
reliable, transparent, and efficient. [Register free as an importer][275] or [list your products as
an exporter][276] and start trading globally today.

CLINICAL GRADE MANUFACTURING

# Science-Driven Oral-Care Manufacturing for Global Brands

Private-label mouthwash, breath sprays, and toothpaste engineered with clinical precision.
ISO-certified and alcohol-free formulations.

[Get formula sheet][19] [Request OEM Quotation][20]

## ISO/GMP-Compliant Production

Manufacturing processes audited for safety and consistency

## Alcohol-Free & Clean-Label Formulations

Modern formulations free from harsh chemicals and additives

## Stability & Micro-tested in Professional Labs

Rigorous lab testing for shelf-life and microbiological safety

## Core Product Categories

We specialize in high-stability liquid and paste formulations, offering turn-key solutions for
private label brands.

[

## Mouthwash OEM

Clean-label, alcohol-free formulations engineered for hotels, retail, and emerging oral-care brands.

][21]
[

## Breath Spray OEM

Portable freshness with safe, regulation-compliant micro-dosing systems.

][22]

## Toothpaste OEM

High-performance formulas for whitening, sensitivity care, and enzyme-based oral care.

][23]

## Streamlined OEM Process

From concept to shelf, our standardized workflow ensures transparency and speed to market.

1

### Briefing

Share your brand goals, target markets, and functional requirements.

2

### Formulation

Our R&D develops stable, compliant bases tailored to your needs.

3

### Packaging

Select bottles, tubes, or sprays optimized for your brand and logistics.

4

### Sampling

Receive test samples for evaluation and market validation.

5

### Testing & Compliance

Comprehensive micro, stability, and safety validation.

6

### Production & Delivery

ISO/GMP batch manufacturing, QC release, global shipping.

[Explore More][25]

R&D EXCELLENCE

## Formulation Backed by Real Laboratory Science

We don't just mix ingredients, we engineer stability. From pH balancing to microbiological
screening, every batch follows a controlled, traceable validation process.

Strict pH balancing and viscosity control

Microbiological screening for every batch

Raw material traceability system

ISO 22716

GMP Certified

Third-party Tested

Stability Protocols

[Explore More][26]

## Experience Our Quality

Order a comprehensive sample kit to evaluate our formulas and packaging systems before full-scale
production.

[Request Sample Kit][27]

Brand Positioning

## Who We Are

is a specialized oral-care OEM solution provider offering formulation, testing, packaging, and
manufacturing services for mouthwash, breath sprays, and toothpaste. We support emerging brands,
hotels, distributors, and retailers with stable, compliant, ready-to-scale product systems.

[Explore more][28]

## Oral Care Solutions

Tailored OEM solutions for diverse market segments and distribution channels

### Hotels & Hospitality

Deliver premium amenities with clean-label oral care designed for international travelers.

### Retail & Distributors

Deliver premium amenities with clean-label oral care designed for international travelers.

### Private-Label Brands

Support for formula selection, packaging, compliance, and startup scaling.

### Travel & Airlines

Mini-format oral care engineered for transportation safety and convenience.

[Explore More][29]

## What our customers say about us

Experience shared by our partners

formulations without unnecessary additives and exceptional guidance at every step. The products look
premium and perform very well in the market
Elena Costa
founder of private-label brand

formulas to make them safer, more stable, and more effective. I especially appreciated how smoothly
they handled manufacturing and compliance. The final products look luxurious and consistently
deliver top-tier performance
Emily Hartman
Founder & Creative Director

consistent, certifications are comprehensive, and production timelines stay predictable—an essential
factor for retail planning. The product range fits both mainstream and premium categories. Our
partners consistently highlight the quality and packaging. Sales improved noticeably within the
first quarter.
Kenji Watanabe
Sales Manager

Elevating Products Through Trusted Collaboration

well-being.

* More than $19.3 million in product donations to support initiatives ranging from humanitarian to

The most common question I get: what is the one thing I can do to improve my health?  I’ll tell you.
It’s free and within your power.

**Lower your resting heart rate before bed.**

After spending years working on health, lowering your resting heart rate (RHR) before bed is the
single most effective thing you can do for your health. Why? **Because sleep is the best performance
enhancing drug in the world. Get your dose every night. **

The reason why RHR works: when your resting heart rate (RHR) is low, your sleep is better. When your
sleep is better, you’re more likely to exercise and eat well. When you exercise and eat well…you do
more positive things for your health. 

Conversely, if your RHR is high, you won’t sleep well. Then you won’t exercise and you’ll eat
poorly. Poor sleep destroys your self control. A vicious cycle.

What increases your RHR before bed?

────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────
Activity                            │Increase in resting heart rate 
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Alcohol before bedtime              │5-10 bpm                       
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Anxiety, stress, rumination         │5-25 bpm                       
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Late-day caffeine                   │2-5 bpm                        
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Intense evening exercise            │4-10 bpm                       
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Large evening meals                 │5-15 bpm                       
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Nicotine                            │5-15 bpm                       
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Dehydration                         │3-8 bpm                        
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
High bedroom, body temp             │3-8 bpm                        
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Certain meds (e.g. ADHD stimulants) │3-10 bpm                       
────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────

## **Do these things to lower your resting heart rate before bed**
1. **Eat your final meal/snack of the day four hours before bed. **I stop eating around noon each
   day and that will get my RHR to around 39 beats per minute right before bed. If I achieve that,
   I’m going to have a perfect night’s sleep. If my RHR is 56 because I ate an hour before bed, my
   sleep quality will be around 30-40% worse.
2. **Screens off 60 minutes before bed.** Your body needs time to wind down. Your phone will keep
   you stimulated via doomscrolling, work and other activities.
3. **Read a book ten minutes before bed.** In the sixty minutes before bed, do your hobby, listen to
   a podcast, read, go for a walk, journal, meditate, breathwork, or call a friend. Things that calm
   your mind. 
4. **Be mindful of stimulants like caffeine**, which has a half life of 6 hours. A cup of coffee at
   4 pm leaves a half a cup of coffee in your system at 10 pm when you’re trying to go to sleep. 
5. **Use red and amber lights in the evening**. Bluelight is bad for sleep. You can get blue light
   blocking apps (f.lux), glasses and also turn red mode on your phone. 
6. **No fights after 5 pm**. Fight in the morning when you’re well rested. 

## **Master these 5 habits**

People read the headlines about me and mistakenly believe that what I do is not accessible to them.
The opposite is true: you can achieve similar health benefits by building some simple life habits.
1. **Sleep – **high quality sleep is the world’s #1 longevity drug. It underpins every healthy
   behavior including exercise, nutrition, and emotional resilience. I’ve built my life around great
   sleep, and I encourage you to do the same.
2. **Nutrition –** I abide by a philosophy that every calorie must fight for its life. See the Don’t
   Die food guide below. The key here, try to never let your mind make eating decisions on your
   behalf. Build and rely upon life systems. 
3. **Exercise** – 6 hours a week is ideal. Incorporate strength, cardio, flexibility and balance. If
   you can’t do that, even 20 minutes a day is great. 
4. **Family, friendship and community** – love and be loved. It will extend your life. 
5. **Things to avoid** – fast food, junk food, smoking, nicotine, vaping, excessive alcohol and
   social media – and anything addictive. Addiction makes you a prisoner. 

## **How to avoid bad habits**

Years ago I could not stop myself** **from overeating everyday at 7 pm. I was building a startup,
had three little kids, struggling to get along with my partner, and having an existential crisis
with my born-into religion. The pressures of life forced me into the open arms of stress-eating. 

One day out of desperation, I said “*Evening Bryan, you’re fired. You make my life miserable. I
can’t sleep. I’m 60 lbs overweight and I feel awful all the time.*”

Giving that version of me a name and then writing down his persuasive tactics such as “*tonight is
the last night*” or “*tomorrow we’ll work extra hard to burn off the calories”* gave me the tools I
needed to stand my ground. Evening Bryan’s authority to eat between 5 pm and 10 pm was revoked. No
matter what, Evening Bryan cannot eat food because if given the chance, he’ll eat too much and ruin
life for Sleep Bryan, Morning Bryan, Work Bryan and Dad Bryan. 

We all have bad habits. Things we do that we don’t really want to do. They never actually make us
happy. They in fact make us sad and regretful. We all know this to be true.

Here’s one approach to move past your bad habits:
1. Identify a version of you that is responsible for self destructive behavior and give them a name
   (i.e. Evening Bryan).
2. Write down the persuasion techniques they use to get what they want (“today’s the last day”). 
3. Prepare a list of rebuttals that enables you to stand your ground (“this is not what we really
   want”, “we know this makes us sad and regretful”). 
4. Identify which versions of you should be in charge (i.e. Morning you) and give them the authority
   to make decisions on behalf of your Evening Bryan.
5. Make firm rules about what you will and won’t do. **None is easier than some. **

## **What is the protocol?**

**What is the Blueprint Protocol? **

I think it’s the best health protocol in the world. And I’m going to make it easy for you.

I’m going to guide you to do fewer, not more things for your health. Habits and not expensive,
exotic therapies.

As you progress, I’ll help you level up to do the best therapies too. 

I promise you, if you implement my protocol, you will feel better than you can remember. I promise
you. As we go through this, you’re going to feel the tension of your current habits, social
obligations, and existing lifestyle. Don’t worry. We’ll work through it. Step by step. But again, I
promise you. On the other side is a version of you begging your current self to take this seriously
and give it a go.

* vascular function: late teen / early 20s
* sleep: top quartile for 18-29-year-olds
* grip strength: top 5% of all ages
* blood glucose: lower than 98% of 18-25-year-olds
* blood sugar control: better than 99% of 18-25-year-olds

I share this to give you hope that you can meaningfully change your health for the better. There are
of course limitations with today’s science, but more can be accomplished than most people think. 

## **What is the one thing I can do to improve my health?**

The most common question I get: what is the one thing I can do to improve my health?  I’ll tell you.
It’s free and within your power.

**Lower your resting heart rate before bed.**

After spending years working on health, lowering your resting heart rate (RHR) before bed is the
single most effective thing you can do for your health. Why? **Because sleep is the best performance
enhancing drug in the world. Get your dose every night. **

The reason why RHR works: when your resting heart rate (RHR) is low, your sleep is better. When your
sleep is better, you’re more likely to exercise and eat well. When you exercise and eat well…you do
more positive things for your health. 

Conversely, if your RHR is high, you won’t sleep well. Then you won’t exercise and you’ll eat
poorly. Poor sleep destroys your self control. A vicious cycle.

What increases your RHR before bed?

────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────
Activity                            │Increase in resting heart rate 
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Alcohol before bedtime              │5-10 bpm                       
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Anxiety, stress, rumination         │5-25 bpm                       
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Late-day caffeine                   │2-5 bpm                        
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Intense evening exercise            │4-10 bpm                       
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Large evening meals                 │5-15 bpm                       
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Nicotine                            │5-15 bpm                       
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Dehydration                         │3-8 bpm                        
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
High bedroom, body temp             │3-8 bpm                        
────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────
Certain meds (e.g. ADHD stimulants) │3-10 bpm                       
────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────

## **Do these things to lower your resting heart rate before bed**
1. **Eat your final meal/snack of the day four hours before bed. **I stop eating around noon each
   day and that will get my RHR to around 39 beats per minute right before bed. If I achieve that,
   I’m going to have a perfect night’s sleep. If my RHR is 56 because I ate an hour before bed, my
   sleep quality will be around 30-40% worse.
2. **Screens off 60 minutes before bed.** Your body needs time to wind down. Your phone will keep
   you stimulated via doomscrolling, work and other activities.
3. **Read a book ten minutes before bed.** In the sixty minutes before bed, do your hobby, listen to
   a podcast, read, go for a walk, journal, meditate, breathwork, or call a friend. Things that calm
   your mind. 
4. **Be mindful of stimulants like caffeine**, which has a half life of 6 hours. A cup of coffee at
   4 pm leaves a half a cup of coffee in your system at 10 pm when you’re trying to go to sleep. 
5. **Use red and amber lights in the evening**. Bluelight is bad for sleep. You can get blue light
   blocking apps (f.lux), glasses and also turn red mode on your phone. 
6. **No fights after 5 pm**. Fight in the morning when you’re well rested. 

## **Master these 5 habits**

People read the headlines about me and mistakenly believe that what I do is not accessible to them.
The opposite is true: you can achieve similar health benefits by building some simple life habits.
1. **Sleep – **high quality sleep is the world’s #1 longevity drug. It underpins every healthy
   behavior including exercise, nutrition, and emotional resilience. I’ve built my life around great
   sleep, and I encourage you to do the same.
2. **Nutrition –** I abide by a philosophy that every calorie must fight for its life. See the Don’t
   Die food guide below. The key here, try to never let your mind make eating decisions on your
   behalf. Build and rely upon life systems. 
3. **Exercise** – 6 hours a week is ideal. Incorporate strength, cardio, flexibility and balance. If
   you can’t do that, even 20 minutes a day is great. 
4. **Family, friendship and community** – love and be loved. It will extend your life. 
5. **Things to avoid** – fast food, junk food, smoking, nicotine, vaping, excessive alcohol and
   social media – and anything addictive. Addiction makes you a prisoner. 

## **How to avoid bad habits**

Years ago I could not stop myself** **from overeating everyday at 7 pm. I was building a startup,
had three little kids, struggling to get along with my partner, and having an existential crisis
with my born-into religion. The pressures of life forced me into the open arms of stress-eating. 

One day out of desperation, I said “*Evening Bryan, you’re fired. You make my life miserable. I
can’t sleep. I’m 60 lbs overweight and I feel awful all the time.*”

Giving that version of me a name and then writing down his persuasive tactics such as “*tonight is
the last night*” or “*tomorrow we’ll work extra hard to burn off the calories”* gave me the tools I
needed to stand my ground. Evening Bryan’s authority to eat between 5 pm and 10 pm was revoked. No
matter what, Evening Bryan cannot eat food because if given the chance, he’ll eat too much and ruin
life for Sleep Bryan, Morning Bryan, Work Bryan and Dad Bryan. 

We all have bad habits. Things we do that we don’t really want to do. They never actually make us
happy. They in fact make us sad and regretful. We all know this to be true.

Here’s one approach to move past your bad habits:
1. Identify a version of you that is responsible for self destructive behavior and give them a name
   (i.e. Evening Bryan).
2. Write down the persuasion techniques they use to get what they want (“today’s the last day”). 
3. Prepare a list of rebuttals that enables you to stand your ground (“this is not what we really
   want”, “we know this makes us sad and regretful”). 
4. Identify which versions of you should be in charge (i.e. Morning you) and give them the authority
   to make decisions on behalf of your Evening Bryan.
5. Make firm rules about what you will and won’t do. **None is easier than some. **

## **What is the protocol?**

**What is the Blueprint Protocol? **

I think it’s the best health protocol in the world. And I’m going to make it easy for you.

I’m going to guide you to do fewer, not more things for your health. Habits and not expensive,
exotic therapies.

As you progress, I’ll help you level up to do the best therapies too. 

I promise you, if you implement my protocol, you will feel better than you can remember. I promise
you. As we go through this, you’re going to feel the tension of your current habits, social
obligations, and existing lifestyle. Don’t worry. We’ll work through it. Step by step. But again, I
promise you. On the other side is a version of you begging your current self to take this seriously
and give it a go.

High-quality sleep changed my life. It took me years to build the habits and systems that led to my

## CARE FOR YOUR MANE

Hair care is necessary to keep hair healthy and shiny, protect it from environmental factors and
styling, promote growth, and boost self-esteem. A good hair care routine can keep the scalp clean
and healthy, lowering the risk of infections and nourishing the hair and scalp for healthy growth.
[Know More][65]
[517x517_3x_c78cc551-bc4d-4bc6-aa57-8a5f6bdfd531]

## RESTORING SKIN AFTER SUN EXPOSURE

In the world of aesthetics, there could be no bigger witness than you for the toll that sun exposure
can take on your clients’ skin. And as an expert, you seek solutions that not only reverse sun
damage but also promote lasting skin health and radiance. 
[Know More][66]
[Moisturizing_Syndet_Bar_56a6d54c-59e1-4d35-86c4-b433545f878f]

## REJUVINATING SKIN

No one better than an aesthetic medicine practitioner can understand the importance of skin
rejuvenation in enhancing your clients’ natural beauty. We understand that lackluster skin can be
one of the most common concerns in your consultation, and we are here with solutions for you to
address this effectively.
[Know More][67]
[Niacinamide_Hyaluronic_Acid_Serum]

## BANISHING UNDER-EYE DARK CIRCLES

Dark circles under the eyes or periorbital hyperpigmentation can be a persistent concern for many
individuals seeking aesthetic dermatological care. As experts in the field, you recognise the unique
challenges posed by this delicate area when you consult your clients.
[Know More][68]

### Brush away plaque with TePe EasyFit™

Because brushing between your teeth can help you get healthy teeth for life. Why not start this
little habit with [TePe EasyFit™][14], which easily brushes away plaque that your toothbrush can't.
It's never too late to start…

[
Start today
][15]

### Easy oral care routine

Did you know that a toothbrush alone only cleans up to 60% of your teeth? Get a 100% fresh and
healthy smile with a simple 3 step oral care routine! An oral care routine that goes beyond
brushing.

[
Go beyond brushing!
][16]
[A laptop at a desk with post its, a pencil and a note pad]

### Find your distributor

TePe’s products are sold and marketed in over 80 countries worldwide. Find your local contact below.

[
Find your local contact
][17]

### Webinar for dental professionals

Discover our quarterly webinars for dental professionals. Take part of our shared knowledge and keep
updated with our seminars and online lectures within a range of topics.

[
Watch our webinars
][18]
[The Swedish flag]

### Made in Sweden

In 1965 we introduced the triangular dental stick, a significant contribution to dental care at the
time. Today we are a global company with subsidiaries and distribution around the globe. TePe
remains a family owned company, with all manufacturing in Malmö Sweden.

### To bring healthy smiles for life, by inspiring good oral health

Based on our vision, we work to raise awareness about oral health and its connection to general
health. We are proud to say that our products contribute to health and well-being for people all
over the world.

### Our products

Taking care of your mouth means taking care of your health. That's why we continue innovating,
educating, and providing a broad range of products for better oral health. We offer oral care
products for every need, from interdental cleaning, toothbrushes and toothpaste to special brushes
for braces and implants and hydrating products for dry mouth.

[
Discover our products
][19]

### Sustainability

Our ambition has always been to improve people's health and make a real difference. For us, building
a sustainable future is as much about taking responsibility for the planet as creating good
conditions for health.

Sustainability

We challenge ourselves to find new sustainable solutions as the world around us and customer demands

## Our Mission: Redefining Oral Care for a Sustainable Future

Every year, an estimated 3.6 billion plastic toothbrushes are discarded globally, with the vast
majority ending up in our oceans and landfills. These petroleum-based products remain in our
ecosystem for centuries, breaking down into microplastics that threaten marine life and human
health. At theBioPlanet, we refuse to accept this as the status quo. We believe that professional
oral hygiene should never come at the cost of the Earth.

As a premier FSC-certified oral care manufacturer, our mission transcends simple production. We are
on a dedicated quest to help global brands and retailers eliminate unnecessary plastic from their
entire supply chains. Our 15-year manufacturing journey has been defined by a singular goal:
perfecting the delicate balance between high-performance dental hygiene and 100% biodegradable
materials.

We have spent over a decade researching sustainable alternatives that perform as well as, if not
better than, traditional plastics. From FSC-sourced Moso bamboo that undergoes specialized
heat-treatment for water resistance, to plastic-free cornstarch (PLA) floss and natural silk
options, we provide the technical tools for a sustainable revolution.

What sets us apart in the global market is our unwavering commitment to Quality and Ethics. As a
Hasbro-audited facility and a trusted production partner for iconic brands like Peppa Pig, we apply
the same rigorous safety and quality standards to our eco-friendly oral care lines. Our products are
fully certified by FDA, CE, and FSC, ensuring that your brand is backed by transparency and global
compliance.

We don’t just supply products; we partner with visionary brands to reduce the global carbon
footprint and protect our oceans for future generations. We help you transition from “business as
usual” to a leader in the green economy.

Because at the end of the day, there is no Planet ‘B’. Always be the bio Planet!

Let’s lead the change together.

## Why Choose Us

Let’s work together to make contributions to environmental protection and health.

### Strong Production Chain

Our powerhouse production line operates with efficiency, supported by a dedicated team in
labor-intensive workshops. We tackle large-scale projects with precision and expertise, ensuring
superior results.

### Fulfill Our Custom Customize Needs

Our products are tailored to meet customer demands, fostering sales by prioritizing client-center
customization. We listen, adapt, and deliver precisely what our customers desire, driving
satisfaction and loyalty.

### All-Around After-Sales Solution

Our comprehensive after-sales service operates round-the-clock, addressing customer needs until
complete satisfaction is achieved. We prioritize excellence, offering personalized solutions to
ensure a seamless and perfect experience.

### Multiple sales channels to meet different needs

We have established deep cooperative relationships with famous brands of oral products at domestic
and foreign, supermarkets, hotels, airlines, etc.

## Latest Products

Our company has customers all over the world, primarily in the United States, Canada, the United
Kingdom, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Japan etc.

## Our Mission: Redefining Oral Care for a Sustainable Future

Every year, an estimated 3.6 billion plastic toothbrushes are discarded globally, with the vast
majority ending up in our oceans and landfills. These petroleum-based products remain in our
ecosystem for centuries, breaking down into microplastics that threaten marine life and human
health. At theBioPlanet, we refuse to accept this as the status quo. We believe that professional
oral hygiene should never come at the cost of the Earth.

As a premier FSC-certified oral care manufacturer, our mission transcends simple production. We are
on a dedicated quest to help global brands and retailers eliminate unnecessary plastic from their
entire supply chains. Our 15-year manufacturing journey has been defined by a singular goal:
perfecting the delicate balance between high-performance dental hygiene and 100% biodegradable
materials.

We have spent over a decade researching sustainable alternatives that perform as well as, if not
better than, traditional plastics. From FSC-sourced Moso bamboo that undergoes specialized
heat-treatment for water resistance, to plastic-free cornstarch (PLA) floss and natural silk
options, we provide the technical tools for a sustainable revolution.

What sets us apart in the global market is our unwavering commitment to Quality and Ethics. As a
Hasbro-audited facility and a trusted production partner for iconic brands like Peppa Pig, we apply
the same rigorous safety and quality standards to our eco-friendly oral care lines. Our products are
fully certified by FDA, CE, and FSC, ensuring that your brand is backed by transparency and global
compliance.

We don’t just supply products; we partner with visionary brands to reduce the global carbon
footprint and protect our oceans for future generations. We help you transition from “business as
usual” to a leader in the green economy.

Because at the end of the day, there is no Planet ‘B’. Always be the bio Planet!

Let’s lead the change together.

## Why Choose Us

Let’s work together to make contributions to environmental protection and health.

### Strong Production Chain

Our powerhouse production line operates with efficiency, supported by a dedicated team in
labor-intensive workshops. We tackle large-scale projects with precision and expertise, ensuring
superior results.

### Fulfill Our Custom Customize Needs

Our products are tailored to meet customer demands, fostering sales by prioritizing client-center
customization. We listen, adapt, and deliver precisely what our customers desire, driving
satisfaction and loyalty.

### All-Around After-Sales Solution

Our comprehensive after-sales service operates round-the-clock, addressing customer needs until
complete satisfaction is achieved. We prioritize excellence, offering personalized solutions to
ensure a seamless and perfect experience.

### Multiple sales channels to meet different needs

We have established deep cooperative relationships with famous brands of oral products at domestic
and foreign, supermarkets, hotels, airlines, etc.

## Latest Products

Our company has customers all over the world, primarily in the United States, Canada, the United
Kingdom, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Japan etc.
